Today, in addition to launching two new products, Sonos also unveiled its software platform brand "Sonos 27" and provided details on four new features coming to Sonos users.

Below are the four new "Sonos 27" features launching this autumn

Today Sonos launched the Sonos Ace Ultra over-ear headphones, alongside the Sonos Beam Ultra soundbar. In addition to new hardware, the company has also rebuilt its software brand.

"Sonos 27" is the official name of Sonos' software platform — the platform itself has actually existed for some time, but only from today does it carry this official name. Sonos also announced four new software features coming this autumn:

  • Portable Surround Sound
  • Personal Listening
  • Sonos 27 Voice
  • Sonos MCP

Portable Surround Sound

Personal Listening, Seamless Experience

A brand-new Sonos voice experience

Control Sonos using the AI you already use

You can find full details of these new Sonos 27 features on the Sonos website, including specific launch timings and early-access arrangements.

What do you think of Sonos' latest announcement and the Sonos 27 software platform? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
